decision.explanation: The question asks who the CEO of Apple was in 2021. Document d2 explicitly states that Tim Cook has been the CEO since 2011 and that he succeeded Steve Jobs after Jobs resigned. Document d3 also directly refers to Tim Cook as the Apple CEO in 2021. Steve Jobs is incorrectly listed as a candidate because he was no longer CEO in 2021 and the audit confirms this contradiction. Therefore, 'Tim Cook' is the only valid and supported answer.
